title: At the School Gate
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先阅读短文，再按原文答题。共 8 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用短文中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。
passage:
A. My name is Li Ming. I am a student. I am not a teacher. I am at the school gate. The school gate is big and blue. I am early. My bag is black.

B. My friend is Wang Fang. She is a student too. She is not late. Her bag is red. We are happy. Our classroom is near the gate. It is small and clean. Our books are on the desks. We are not in the classroom now. Our teacher is Mr. Chen. He is at the gate. "Are you ready?" he asks. "Yes, we are," we say. We are ready for class.

questions.explanation: 原文明确说“I am not a teacher.”，所以李明不是老师。
原文说“The school gate is big and blue.”，所以学校大门很大。
questions.evidence: The school gate is big and blue.

questions.explanation: Wang Fang 后面的 she 指王芳，原文明确说她也是学生。
原文说“She is not late.”，所以王芳没有迟到。
原文说“We are happy.”，所以他们是开心的。

questions.prompt: 从短文中抄写一个英文词：李明的包是黑色的。My bag is ______.
questions.explanation: A 段是李明的自我介绍，他说包是黑色的。

questions.prompt: 从短文中抄写一个英文姓氏：Their teacher is Mr. ______.
questions.explanation: B 段说明老师是陈老师，姓氏写作 Chen。

questions.prompt: 从短文中抄写一个英文词：学校大门是蓝色的。The school gate is big and ______.
questions.explanation: A 段说大门又大又蓝，所以填 blue。
questions.evidence: The school gate is big and blue.

grammar.title: be动词否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: be动词（am, is, are）的否定句是在be动词后加not，例如“I am not a teacher.”。一般疑问句是把be动词提到主语前面，例如“Are you a student?”。简短回答用Yes或No，例如“Yes, I am.”或“No, I am not.”。
